vulnerability.explanation: Indices parsed from the input file (variable 'from') are used to index the stack array 'states[1000]' without bounds checking. If 'from' >= 1000, 'if (states[from] == NULL)' reads out of bounds and the subsequent assignment 'states[from] = xmlAutomataNewState(am);' writes out of bounds. This is reachable via 't ' lines in the test file. Similar unsafe accesses also occur for 'to' at lines 4960-4961 and in the 'e ' branch at lines 4975 and 4979.
